column1: # The design-decision worklist: one line per entry of the register (DESIGN_DECISIONS_*.md),
# with the sites that keep it and the work it still owes.  Query and revalidate it with
# reads the same counts.  DESIGN_DECISIONS_RULES.md § Using the register says what a line means.
# Columns (tab-separated; ids bare, so this file cites nothing):
#   kind   code     — code implements or refuses it; `site` names where
#          decline  — nothing implements it (it is an absence); `note` says what keeps it
#          library  — it is about a library and is kept there
#          ?        — not classified yet (`sync` adds a new entry this way)
#   site   `path` or `path::text` (a literal the file contains), `; `-separated; `?` unknown, `-` none
#   guard  ok | weak (a guard cites it but does not exercise it; `note` says what is missing)
#   work   `-` or a comma list of: cite (a site lacks @C<n>), locate (find the site),
#          guard (write a guard that exercises it), entry (the entry text disagrees with the
#          code), miscite (a site cites the wrong id), build (pending), classify (new line)
